Buoy maintenance notes

Office suite spans carry inline styles that the profile drops.

Right in a right-to-left paragraph is its start.

A div soup line

and a second with a font tag



after an empty line

Handlers, classes, styles and unknown data attributes vanish; the center alignment stays.

A script link keeps its text, a fragment link and a relative link stay.

Buoy on its mooring

A nested quote

and the outer quote's text

Bold alias, italic alias, deleted alias, an unnamed mark, a teal mark and a color outside the palette.

bold code loses its bold; subscript with superscript inside keeps the inner mark.

A task item copied from an editing root
